answer: The crystal graph is rebuilt each epoch, which means the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the raven audit merges it again. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the fable checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 9 times its size, so a group of 56 keys loses far more than 56 single identities would. That is 36 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
